findings.title: No submit button visible inside the login card
findings.description: The criterion expects the login form's submit button to be fully visible inside the card and viewport. The card runs from roughly x=64 to x=735 and y=44 to y=383 and contains only the "Login" heading, the "Email" label with its field, and the "Password" label with its field. The region of the card below the password field (about y=300 to y=383) is unmasked plain white with no control, glyph, border or fill of any kind, and no button-like element appears anywhere else inside the card or in the surrounding viewport background. Hypothesis: the submit control is either not rendered, rendered with zero/collapsed size, or positioned outside the captured 800x600 viewport, so the criterion is not visibly satisfied in this capture.
findings.suggestedCheck: In the running app at 800x600, query the form for a submit control (button[type=submit] or input[type=submit]) and assert it exists, is not display:none/visibility:hidden, and has a non-zero bounding box. Then assert its getBoundingClientRect() is fully contained within the card element's rect and within the viewport (top>=0, left>=0, right<=innerWidth, bottom<=innerHeight).

findings.title: Verify no horizontal overflow at the captured viewport width
findings.description: The criterion also requires that the form be reachable without horizontal scrolling. In this capture the card's own right edge is inside the viewport at about x=735, and no scrollbar chrome is visible, so the card container itself shows no overflow evidence. This is recorded only as a check to run independently, not as an observed defect: the capture cannot confirm whether inner form content extends past the card or the document width at this viewport size.
findings.suggestedCheck: At an 800x600 viewport, assert document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth, and for each form control assert its rect.right <= the card content-box right edge. Repeat after focusing the submit control to confirm it does not require scrolling into view.
